note: Every bound operand is tied to a vulnerable-original expression already present on the selected root-to-sink path. The required operand is deliberately the signed view `(int32_t)nbytes`: the vulnerable harness only checks `nbytes == 0`, but the traced failure requires the missing conjunct `((int32_t)nbytes) > 0` before `blosc_decompress(...)` is allowed to execute. Literal fields ending in `.zero_literal` are compile-time constants and intentionally omitted.
